title: Twitter3
tagline: Guide Twitter's tens of millions of users into Web3 naturally
description:
Twitter is currently the largest web3 communication platform.
There are tens of millions of twitter users, but a small portion of web3 users.
A lot of Twitter original content is full of meaning, and it should belong to the user.
But Twitter is centralized and post or account can be deleted/changed by twitter company without permission form account owner. 

We try to create a DAPP to bring more uses into web3 space naturally and enjoy features of web3. 

Below are some cases:
- Let twitter users without web3 knowledge say hello to web3 with web2 account.
- Let web users mint/claim their twitter content/ twitter id as NFT to  Make twitter content forever
- Engage users to  a specific DAPP or a chain with a easy way.
- Twitting from twitter3 will mint post NFT directly, and history twitter post can be claimed as nft too.
how_its_made:
- Login to DAPP with twitter base on AA and MPC tech (using safe, web auth)
- Mint free NFT by just 2 clicks

- Claim twitter handle as NFT  (ERC 6551？)
